title: Cursor lag from the backup save disrupts flow (2026-11-09)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: It's noticable that my cursor gets stuck regularly. Just for a moment. This is probably our saving to backup. It's not bad, but the lag now and then can disrupt flow.

sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-09, while writing the μ.democracy theory-of-change essay in the srs web editor; recorded verbatim, typo included.
